name: Abraxas
source:
The uptight and brooding captain of North Haven's Supernatural Secrecy Force.

Beneath the aloof facade Abraxas has clung to for the past two centuries, repressed desires fester.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3474200/Burn_the_Midnight_Oil/]Steam[/url]]

Romance option for Circe.
